name: claude-speedometer
description: Indicator showing the token throughput and timing of your Claude Code interactions.

commands.title: Claude Speedometer: Show / Hide Stats Tab
Claude Speedometer: Configure Claude Code Telemetry

claudeSpeedometer.port.description: Localhost port the embedded OTLP/HTTP receiver listens on. Must match the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT configured for Claude Code.

claudeSpeedometer.exportIntervalMs.description: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORT_INTERVAL written when auto-configuring Claude Code. Lower = more responsive status bar, more frequent exports.

claudeSpeedometer.statusBarPriority.description: Status bar priority within the right-hand cluster. Higher = further left, lower = further right.

claudeSpeedometer.retentionDays.description: Discard interactions older than this many days from the shared history file (~/.claude-speedometer/state.json).

claudeSpeedometer.providers.markdownDescription: Per-token rates for providers Claude Code cannot price, which it otherwise costs at its own default model's rate. Nested provider then model: the outer key is a name you choose, `endpoint` is the `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` its traffic goes to (a string, or a list when one provider answers at several URLs), and `models` maps a model id to its four rates plus any ids the server reports it as. Models are matched exactly, against the id the response carries; there is no wildcard, so a model with no rate reads as "unpriced" rather than being absorbed into a blanket figure.

endpoint.description: The `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` this provider is reached at, matched case-insensitively with its path kept. Omit it to have these rates apply only when a turn's base URL cannot be resolved at all.

cacheWrite.description: USD per million cache-write tokens. Not derivable from `input`: Anthropic surcharges a write, a gateway billing only input / cached input / output does not.

reportedAs.description: Other model ids this rate also applies to, for a provider that resolves the requested id server-side. Fireworks serves `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3` but reports `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3` on every streamed request, and Claude Code only streams, so without the alias the rate never matches.

claudeSpeedometer.billingContextProvider.markdownDescription: Which extension to ask where Claude Code is sending requests. `auto` takes the first extension in this window that exports a `getBillingContext()` function and reports itself armed, `off` asks none, and any other value pins a single extension id.
